question.problem:
Consider the following matrices:

$$
{B}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}0 & 6 \\ 9 & 7\end{aligned}],\,{B}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 1 & 8\end{aligned}],\,A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ -7 & 9\end{aligned}]
$$

If $B=\{{B}_{1},{B}_{2}\}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}\{{B}_{1},{B}_{2}\},$ and $[A]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}],$ then ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=$
question.worked_solution:
We need to find ${x}_{1}$ and ${x}_{2}$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{B}_{1}+{x}_{2}{B}_{2}=A.
$$

Substituting the given information into the above equation, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}[\begin{aligned}0 & 6 \\ 9 & 7\end{aligned}]+{x}_{2}[\begin{aligned}1 & 5 \\ 1 & 8\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ -7 & 9\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}{x}_{2} & 6{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2} \\ 9{x}_{1}+{x}_{2} & 7{x}_{1}+8{x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}2 & 4 \\ -7 & 9\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding entries, we obtain

$$
\{\begin{aligned}{x}_{2}=2 \\ 6{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=4 \\ 9{x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-7 \\ 7{x}_{1}+8{x}_{2}=9.\end{aligned}
$$

 

The equations above give a linear system with the augmented matrix

$$
M=[\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 & 4 \\ 9 & 1 & -7 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{aligned}].
$$

Row-reducing the matrix using Gaussian elimination, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}M= & [\begin{aligned}0 & 1 & 2 \\ 6 & 5 & 4 \\ 9 & 1 & -7 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{1}↔{R}_{2}\end{aligned} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}6 & 5 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 9 & 1 & -7 \\ 7 & 8 & 9\end{aligned}] &  & \begin{aligned}{R}_{3}:={R}_{3}+(-\frac{3}{2}){R}_{1} \\ {R}_{4}:={R}_{4}+(-\frac{7}{6}){R}_{1}\end{aligned} \\ ∼ & [\begin{aligned}6 & 5 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 2 \\ 0 & -\frac{13}{2} & -13 \\ 0 & \frac{13}{6} & \frac{13}{3}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

The system is now 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1}+5{x}_{2}=4 \\ {x}_{2}=2 \\ -\frac{13}{2}{x}_{2}=-13 \\ \frac{13}{6}{x}_{2}=\frac{13}{3}.\end{aligned}
$$

From the second, third and fourth equations, we get ${x}_{2}=2.$ From the first equation, we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}_{1}+5\cdot 2 & =4 \\ 6{x}_{1} & =-6 \\ {x}_{1} & =-1.\end{aligned}
$$

 

Therefore, $[A]_{B}=[\begin{aligned}-1 \\ 2\end{aligned}].$

Finally, ${x}_{1}+{x}_{2}=-1+2=1.$
